subject: Live lab: sandbox slot sync + prompt load validation
messages:
From: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Khan <sam.khan@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: POC live lab + load validation (next week?)

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the routing and caching controls. We'd like to move to a hands-on live lab so our engineers can validate prompt formats, routing fallbacks, and a short load validation to estimate unit economics.

Goal: 90–120 minute working session where Redwood and NimbleHealth engineers walk through: prompt review, routing policies, KV/prefix caching behavior, and a 10–15 minute targeted load run (burst + steady).

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue 11/10 after 10:00
- Wed 11/11 morning 09:00–12:00
- Thu 11/12 13:00–16:00

We can share a short requirements spreadsheet (attached) and two engineers will join from our side: myself and Sam (lead engineer). Can you propose an agenda and confirm Redwood's recommended load window (what's safe vs. aggressive)?

Attachments:
- nimble-prod-requirements.xlsx (requirements + sample prompt sets)

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Director, Platform Integrations
NimbleHealth
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: POC live lab + load validation (next week?)

Hi Elaine — great to hear, and thanks for sending the requirements. Looping in Marissa and Ben for load/runbook details; Tessa will own the prompt/workshop flow.

I propose a tight 90-minute working session and an agenda draft below. Please tell us which of the windows you prefer (we'll hold all three tentatively until you confirm):

Draft agenda (90 min):
- 00:00–00:10 Intro + goals (all)
- 00:10–00:30 Prompt review & sample inputs (Redwood + Nimble) — Tessa
- 00:30–00:45 Routing policy walkthrough (how fallbacks work; region pinning) — Mateo
- 00:45–01:05 KV/prefix caching and live tracing (Marissa)
- 01:05–01:20 Targeted load validation (Ben leads; 10–15 min run; 5 min cooldown)
- 01:20–01:30 Next steps + action items

Attachments I'm including: lab-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda + slide placeholders) and runbook-deployment-checklist.md (what we'll run on the day). Ben — see load questions inline.

Quick load questions for Nimble:
1) Target throughput goal for the short run (requests/sec) and target p95 latency objective?
2) Any IP/network or firewall constraints for hitting your staging endpoints?

If you confirm a slot today I will send a calendar invite and final pre-reads.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: lab-agenda-v1.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: runbook-deployment-checklist.md (MD)]
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Elaine Park <elaine@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: POC live lab + load validation (next week?)

Thanks — short answers from infra side:
- We recommend a conservative validation profile to start: 50 rps sustained for 10 minutes with a 1-minute 200 rps spike to validate autoscaling and routing fallbacks. That should expose caching behavior without hitting quota cliffs.
- p95 target: <500ms for typical prompt sizes (we'll measure tokens).
- We'll run from Redwood's staging pool; no inbound firewall changes required if you hit the public staging endpoint. If you prefer to hit a private VPC endpoint, Marissa will coordinate credentials and IP allowlist.

I attached the detailed load-plan.md with ramp profiles and metrics we'll collect. We'll also include a small tracing panel in the pre-reads so you can pick which traces you'd like us to capture.

Notes: if Nimble expects higher TPS for a business-critical validation, tell us and we can schedule a longer window dedicated to scale testing.

Ben
Principal Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: load-test-plan.md (MD)]

A few clarifications:
- We'll start with the sample prompts in nimble-prod-requirements.xlsx (you have the file).
- For the private endpoint option: we prefer public staging for this quick validation; no IP tweaks needed.
- Please include a short 'what to expect' slide in the agenda (2 slides) so our PMs can join for the first 10 minutes.

If you can send the calendar invite and final pre-reads, we'll lock the engineers in.

Thanks,
Elaine
